case_number: 2024 INSC 980; CIVIL APPEAL NO. 14473 OF 2024 (ARISING OUT OF SLP (C) NO. 12116 OF 2010), WITH CIVIL APPEAL NO. 14474 OF 2024, CIVIL APPEAL NO. 14475 OF 2024, AND CIVIL APPEAL NO. 14476 OF 2024 (ARISING OUT OF RESPECTIVE SLP(C) NOS.)
summary: Land acquisition validity; delay in writ petitions challenged; Section 52(1) notification under Rajasthan Urban Improvement Act, 1959 upheld; compensation determination and payment examined; lapse of proceedings due to non-award within two years rejected; vesting of land prior to 01.08.1987 shielded from challenge under Section 60A(4); revenue proceedings on land classification (Banjar Kadim vs. Abadi) analyzed; acquisition proceedings quashed by High Court restored; final settlement with interest upheld.
final_judgment: Appeals allowed; High Court judgment quashing acquisition set aside; acquisition proceedings and compensation payment upheld.
